description: This file contains utility functions for handling git operations, detecting changed files, and managing plugin extensions in a Node.js project. It includes methods for listing extensions, resolving base commits, and detecting changed extension IDs based on file paths.

methods.name: runGit
methods.description: Executes a git command with specified arguments in the repository root directory.

methods.name: normalizeRelative
methods.description: Converts a file path to a standardized form with forward slashes.

methods.name: hasGitCommit
methods.description: Checks if a git reference exists and points to a commit.

methods.name: resolveChangedPathsBase
methods.description: Resolves the base commit for comparing changes, considering fallback options.

methods.name: listChangedPaths
methods.description: Lists file paths changed between two git commits.

methods.name: hasExtensionPackage
methods.description: Checks if a specific extension package exists in the plugin directory.

methods.name: listAvailableExtensionIds
methods.description: Returns a sorted list of available extension IDs based on existing plugin directories with package.json files.

methods.name: detectChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Detects extension IDs affected by changes based on file paths.

methods.name: listChangedExtensionIds
methods.description: Main function that determines which extension IDs have changed since a base commit.
